title: Hayati Pro Max Cola Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Cola Lime delivers a sparkling soda-inspired vape that combines the classic sweetness of fizzy Cola with a sharp twist of Lime. The result is a lively blend of caramelised soda notes and citrus zest, offering a refreshing take on a familiar favourite with just the right amount of tang. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid nicotine delivery, and a smoother throat hit, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent vapour and flavour on every puff. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
